en: Hello, I'm a fortune teller. As you can see, there are some weird doors here.
Those are random doors. It means that in each set of color, only one door will open at random.
Don't worry, I can see the future! Just ask me and I'll tell you the number of the door that will open.
To ask me, use the function fortune_teller that I added in your work.py file. The result is a the number of the open door.
On the map, you can see the number of the door on the first line the said door, right above a 'c'.
Adapt your path according to the open door by using conditions!
I added some more comments in your work.py file for you.
